UPCOMING BIKE TOURS

From Italy's lakes, Tuscan hills, and legendary climbs to Portugal's Atlantic coast, Spain's hidden roads, France's greatest passes, sun-soaked islands, and all the way to Slovenia, Croatia and Cyprus — fully supported cycling tours across Europe's best roads.
Every trip is guided by former pro riders who handle the routes, logistics, and bike support, so all you need to do is ride.

Whether you're chasing a Gran Fondo weekend, a multi-day mountain challenge, or a relaxed lakeside escape, there's a trip built for every level.

Can't find the perfect one? Build your own tour. Find out more HERE

2027 CALENDAR

DISCOVER THE ALGARVE & GRAN FONDO

Algarve, Portugal

5 nights/ 6 days

Quiet roads and beautiful coastline is what makes this region unforgettable. A trip suitable to get ready for your spring/summer season whether you are a racer or a leisure rider with an opportunity to ride the Gran Fondo and watch the pro race. Quiet roads and a stunning coastline make this region unforgettable.

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

€1099 | £949 | $1249*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

CHIANTI & GRAN FONDO STRADE BIANCHE

Chianti, Tuscany, Italy.

5 nights / 6 days

Everybody in cycling knows the iconic Strade Bianche. We’ve designed a unique cycling holiday based in the heart of Chianti, where you’ll ride Tuscany’s famous white roads, take part in the Gran Fondo on Sunday, and watch the pros on Saturday. With guaranteed entry, grid start options, and VIP race access, this is the ultimate Strade Bianche experience.

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

From €1349 | £1149 | $1549*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

TOUR OF FLANDERS EXPERIENCE

Flanders, Belgium.

4 nights / 5 days ​

Ride it. Watch it. Live it. Take on the cobbles of the Tour of Flanders weekend in the ultimate cycling experience. Ride the legendary climbs in the We Ride Flanders sportive, then watch the world’s best battle it out on the same roads the very next day with premium race access.From brutal cobbles to electric crowds, this is Flanders at its best.

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 30/11

€1299 | £1149 | $1549*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

CYPRUS CROSSING | GRAVEL

Paphos, Cyprus

7 nights/8 days

Are you ready for the gravel adventure of your lifetime? Cyprus offers endless of gravel routes combined with amazing weather all year round with great food & hospitality. We have designed a unique gravel trip with 80% off road which takes you to the top of Mt Olympus, and across the island. Don't miss out on this trip if you are a gravel lover.

Level: Expert

Early bird price until 30/11 ​

€1399 | £1249 | $1649*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

TUSCANY EPIC | GRAVEL

Castagneto Carducci, Tuscany, Italy

6 nights / 7 days

When you think about Tuscany, as a cycling lover you immediately think about the white roads, cypress trees and rolling green hills. Well, we have built a trip that goes around the whole region in order for to discover and immerse yourself in the Tuscany culture and gastronomy. All with your gravel bike, on 80% off roads. Simply a trip of a lifetime.

Level: Expert

​Early bird price until 31/12

​€1399 | £1249 | $1649*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

MARATONA DLES DOLOMITES - ENEL

Alta Badia, Italy

5 nights/ 6 days

Join Cigala Cycling Tours, an Official Tour Operator of the Maratona dles Dolomites – Enel, for the 40th edition on 4 July 2027. Ride through the spectacular Dolomites, taking on iconic climbs including the Campolongo, Pordoi, Sella, Gardena, Giau and Falzarego, with premium accommodation and full support from our experienced team.

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

​Early bird price until 31/01

From €2249 | £1959 | $2599*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

DOLOMITES

Dolomites, Italy

5 nights/6 days

On this trip you will ride in one of the most spectacular places on Earth. The Dolomites are so mystical and mind-blowing. Everywhere you look, it's a postcard. You will climb some of Italy's famous and beautiful climb: Giau, Gardena, Sella, Pordoi, Campolongo, Falzarego, Valparola, Fedaia, Tre Cime di Lavaredo and San Pellegrino.

Level: Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 28/02

​€1499 | £1349 | $1749*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

ITALIAN ALPS

Bormio, Italy

5 nights/6 days

Take on an unforgettable cycling holiday in the Italian Alps, conquering some of the most legendary climbs in cycling history. Ride the iconic roads of the Giro d'Italia, including the Stelvio, Gavia, Mortirolo, Cancano and Foscagno. Each climb offers its own unique challenge, spectacular alpine scenery and an incredible sense of achievement, making this the ultimate trip for riders looking to experience Italy's most famous mountain passes.

Level: Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 28/02

€1299 | £1149 | $1549*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

ALPINE GRAVEL ESCAPE

Bormio, Italy

5 nights/6 days

Experience the Italian Alps like never before. This unique gravel adventure takes you beyond the tarmac to ride the iconic Stelvio Gravel, spectacular alpine trails and historic military roads through breathtaking mountain landscapes. Designed for adventurous riders, it combines epic climbs, remote gravel routes and unforgettable scenery.

Level: Expert

Early bird price until 28/02

€1299 | £1149 | $1549*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

FRENCH ALPS

French Alps, France

7 nights/ 8 days

Take on an unforgettable cycling holiday in the French Alps, conquering legendary climbs including Col du Galibier, Alpe D'Huez, Col de la Madeleine, Col de la Croix de Fer, Col d'Izoard and the Cime de la Bonette — the highest paved road in the Alps. Each climb offers its own challenge and spectacular scenery, making this the ultimate trip for riders looking to experience France's most iconic mountain passes.

​​Level: Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 28/02

​€1799 | £1549 | $2099*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

WONDERFUL SLOVENIA

West Slovenia, Slovenia

6 nights/7 days

Discover one of Europe's most underrated cycling destinations. This road trip takes you from the dramatic Julian Alps, over the legendary 24 hairpins of the Vršič Pass, down through the turquoise waters of the Soča Valley, and along the shores of Lake Bled. A journey through Slovenia's most spectacular landscapes in a single trip, this is the ultimate way to experience a country most cyclists have never had on their radar.

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 30/04

​€1499 | £1349 | $1749*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

LAKE GARDA & DAY TRIP TO STELVIO

Lake Garda, Italy

5 nights/6 days

One of our most popular trip. Ride in the amazing routes around Lake Garda. Experience the amazing cuisine of the area and immerse yourself in the culture. Finally, on this trip you will have the opportunity to have a day trip and ride Italy's most famous climb: Passo Dello Stelvio!

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 30/04

€1099 | £999 | $1299*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

LAKE GARDA GRAVEL

Lake Garda, Italy

5 nights/6 days

Trade the tarmac for gravel on Lake Garda's quieter side. Based in Moniga del Garda, explore the vineyard tracks of Valtenesi, the Moreniche hills, the Mincio Valley and the renowned Amarone wine region of Valpolicella. Six days of scenic gravel riding, historic villages and some of Italy's finest wine country.

Level: Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 30/04

€1099 | £999 | $1299*

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

ITALY'S COAST TO COAST

Tuscany, Umbria, Marche, Italy

7 nights/8 days

An incredible cycling experience, from coast to coast through the heart of Italy: this road bike tour will take you on unique ride, from the Tyrrhenian Sea to the Adriatic Sea. You will be riding through the most amazing countryside: rolling hills, apennine mountains, hidden medieval villages surrounded by unspoiled nature. Covering three regions in 6 riding days: Tuscany, Umbria & Marche.

Level: Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 30/05

​€1649 | £1449 | $1899*​

MORE DETAILS
BOOK NOW

LAKE COMO, GRAN FONDO IL LOMBARDIA & PRO RACE

Lake Como, Italy

5 nights/6 days

Everybody that is into cycling knows the last monument of the year, "Il Lombardia". We designed a unique Cycling Holiday basing us on a central location for you to discover the beauty of Lake Como, watch the pros and ride the Gran Fondo "Il Lombardia".​ From iconic climbs to lakeside roads, this is the ultimate way to experience Il Lombardia from the inside.

Level: Beginner, Intermediate, Expert

Early bird price until 30/05

€1299 | £1149 | $1499*

MORE DETAILS

BOOK NOW

*Prices in GBP or USD could be slightly different at the time of booking based on the current exchange rate.
